## Before submitting

- [ ] My change includes English translation text, not just notes or formatting.
- [ ] I kept source IDs, hashes and record order unchanged.
- [ ] I synchronized JSON and CSV using `tools/sync_csv.py`.
- [ ] The source page-break count (`\f`) is unchanged.
- [ ] I checked the glossary and read the English aloud.
- [ ] I did not include links, source-script dumps, ROMs, saves or executables.
- [ ] The relevant local checks passed; I described any checks I could not run.
- [ ] Any game file used was my own legally obtained ROM, and no game files, source assets or in-game screenshots are attached.

- [ ] I own or have the necessary permission for the material I submit; no official/fan-project text was copied without permission.
- [ ] I understand code is Apache 2.0-licensed, but the game’s rights and adaptation permission are separate.
